title: Approve the Overview composition
question: Bright Corridor Map is locked. Which composition should the build match?

options.label: Map-led Overview (decision)
options.thesis: Large corridor map beside overview copy; left rail shell.
options.viewport: Left rail + large map work area with Resume on next station.
options.risk: Decision render drifted toward transit marketing; use only if we treat it as spatial reference and rebuild Riffle content faithfully.

options.label: Top bar + corridor stage
options.thesis: Top navigation; the roadmap corridor owns the main stage.
options.viewport: Top tabs; Acoustic Pop line stations lead; Resume on Alternate Picking Mastery; stats aside.
options.risk: Map-as-hero can crowd secondary progress if density is too low.

options.label: Rail + Up Next + compact corridor
options.thesis: Task-first: Up Next strip leads; compact corridor proves the signature move.
options.viewport: Left rail; Resume strip first; horizontal station map; stats and recent scans.
options.risk: Compact map must stay legible or the signature move disappears.
